title: Credit Risk Explainer with Real-Time Fairness & Interpretability
description: Built an interactive, explainable AI dashboard for real-time credit risk prediction using XGBoost, Random Forest, and Logistic Regression, with full model evaluation and comparison.
Implemented local interpretability with SHAP and LIME to provide per-user prediction insights, promoting transparency and trust in AI-driven decision systems.
Designed fairness monitoring modules with disparate impact and equal opportunity metrics, supporting responsible AI and bias detection across user segments.
Deployed a Streamlit dashboard on Streamlit Cloud with real-time user input processing, automated model retraining, and CI/CD deployment via GitHub Actions for continuous delivery.

title: E-commerce Churn Prediction with Real-Time Inference
description: Engineered a real-time ML pipeline with MLflow for experiment tracking, version control, and continuous integration, inspired by GitOps practices for production-ready deployment.
Optimized XGBoost models via Bayesian search, achieving 92.85% accuracy and 0.94 AUC-ROC, while monitoring model fairness, bias drift, and demographic parity.
Built a low-latency inference service using FastAPI with Pydantic-based schema validation, integrated content safety filters, and deployed as a containerized microservice on OpenShift.
Architected a production-grade system using Docker Compose, with multi-container orchestration, automated health checks, and robust CI/CD triggers for real-time deployment.

title: Predictive Analytics for NBA Player Performance and Game Outcomes
description: Designed an end-to-end machine learning pipeline for predicting NBA game outcomes using real-time and historical player behavior data, achieving 83% accuracy.
Engineered 30+ advanced features from raw NBA API streams, modeling individual player dynamics, fatigue, and team synergy for outcome forecasting.
Evaluated and tuned models including XGBoost, LSTM neural networks, and ensemble methods to maximize AUC-ROC, with a 12% performance lift.
Applied time-series analysis to monitor player fatigue and injury risk signals, enhancing model personalization and temporal prediction accuracy by 7%.

title: Pictophrases
description: Conducted a study on advanced image captioning techniques using RNNs, BiLSTMs, and Transformers, achieving a 15% improvement in BLEU score over baseline RNN models.
Built the model architecture from scratch, incorporating InceptionV3 for feature extraction.
Evaluated model performance on the diverse Flickr-8k dataset using the BLEU metric, achieving an average score of 0.35.
Enhanced model accuracy through iterative training, hyperparameter tuning, and dropout regularization, improving validation accuracy by 12%.
Implemented beam search decoding for generating more diverse captions, improving caption quality by 10% according to human evaluation.

title: Implicit Bias Annotation
description: Led research to develop a framework for automated implicit bias annotation using fine-tuned LLAMA-2 models with QLoRA and PEFT for efficiency and scalability.
Applied RAG patterns and designed input/output safety guardrails (prompt filtering, adversarial testing) to enhance reliability and fairness of bias classification in real-world text.
Built explainability modules using LIME and SHAP for model transparency, aligning with AI ethics frameworks and responsible AI principles.
Integrated model evaluation within an MLOps pipeline designed for deployment, including drift detection, bias monitoring, and safety metric tracking.

title: Fraud Detection in Financial Transactions
description: Built a fraud detection system processing financial transactions using supervised and unsupervised learning.
Trained XGBoost on 500K labeled transactions, achieving 0.93 AUC-ROC for fraud classification.
Implemented Isolation Forest with 200 estimators, detecting 98% of anomalies in transaction data.
Reduced dimensionality by 85% using PCA, improving model runtime by 40% without performance loss.
Conducted hyperparameter tuning via GridSearchCV, reducing false positives by 12%.

title: FixMatch Implementation
description: Reproduced FixMatch results on CIFAR-10 using Wide ResNet-28-2, achieving 90% of the performance reported in the original paper.
Implemented weak and strong augmentations with pseudo-labeling, utilizing 95% unlabeled data for training.
Optimized hyperparameters to closely align with the original paper, achieving performance within 5%.
Conducted extensive experiments, demonstrating the effectiveness of semi-supervised learning with 10% higher accuracy than a fully supervised model.
Evaluated various augmentation strategies, improving robustness by 7% compared to standard methods.

title: Medical Chatbot with RAG
description: Built a RAG-based chatbot leveraging LangChain and the Mistral-7B model to generate accurate, context-aware medical responses by combining LLMs with vector search databases.

Integrated Pinecone vector search for efficient indexing and retrieval of medical documents, enabling the chatbot to pull relevant and up-to-date information from a vast knowledgebase based on semantic similarity, improving response accuracy.
Developed Flask API for real-time query handling, text preprocessing, and dynamic response generation.

Designed and implemented custom prompt templates and text preprocessing pipelines, fine-tuning them to optimize the interaction between the model's inputs and outputs, which significantly improved the coherence, relevance, and accuracy of the responses generated by the LLM.

title: ML Pipeline Orchestrator
description: Designed and implemented a lightweight ML pipeline orchestrator entirely from scratch to automate and manage end-to-end ML workflows without external orchestration frameworks.
Developed custom DAG-based dependency management to validate and order task execution dynamically.
Implemented state persistence and checkpointing mechanisms to enable seamless recovery from interruptions.
Built configurable error handling and retry logic, allowing pipelines to recover gracefully from step failures.
Created both a command-line interface and a Python API for flexible usage in scripts or interactive workflows.
Delivered real ML examples, including a PyTorch-based MNIST computer vision pipeline integrated with the orchestrator.

title: Kubernetes-Based ML Inference API
description: Built a full-stack ML inference deployment pipeline supporting real-time sentiment analysis using FastAPI.
Containerized the application using Docker and deployed scalable workloads on Kubernetes, leveraging Kustomize overlays for environment-specific configuration (dev, staging, prod).
Set up robust monitoring using Prometheus and Grafana, exposing custom application metrics and defining alert rules.
Automated continuous integration and deployment workflows using GitHub Actions, ensuring reliable and reproducible deployments across clusters.

title: Automated Data Pipeline Using Spark and Google Cloud
description: Designed and implemented an end-to-end automated data pipeline using Apache Spark and Google Cloud Dataproc to efficiently process and transform large-scale datasets ingested from GCS.
Automated loading of processed data into Google BigQuery for scalable querying and analytics.
Optimized data transformation with Spark, reducing pipeline runtime by 30% and improving efficiency.
Used Google Cloud to automate pipeline execution, triggering Spark jobs on a schedule using Google Cloud Scheduler.

title: Multi-Cloud Data Integration
description: Developed an automated data pipeline to integrate data from AWS S3 and Azure Blob Storage into a centralized GCS Bucket staging area.
Used Apache NiFi to batch process data from multiple cloud environments, ensuring seamless ingestion and staging of files.
Designed transformation workflows within NiFi to clean, format, and enrich data before loading it into Google BigQuery.
Automated the orchestration of batch processes and data transformations using NiFi's scheduling and flow management features, ensuring timely and efficient data integration.
Ensured data security and compliance by applying encryption protocols for data in transit and at rest.

title: Video Panorama Generation
description: Developed a pipeline for generating stabilized panoramas from videos using modular components, reducing processing time by 25%.
Implemented color correction using histogram matching and frame selection based on vibrancy scores.
Integrated video stabilization using an open-source library, improving the overall stability and smoothness of the generated panorama by 30%.
Optimized the stitching algorithm to handle high-resolution videos and reduce artifacts, achieving a 98% success rate in smooth transitions.

title: End-to-End Image Classification on CIFAR-10
description: Implemented a feature extraction pipeline for CIFAR-10 images by flattening pixel data, normalizing the data and applying standard augmentations for robust classification.
Developed a Convolutional Neural Network for image classification on the CIFAR-10 dataset, with custom logging and exception handling to extract hierarchical features from input images.

Utilized MLflow to log and track hyperparameters, performing automated hyperparameter tuning and optimization through experiment tracking to improve model performance and versioning to ensure reproducibility.
Implemented CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions to automate the deployment of a Flask web application, which serves the best performing model for real-time predictions.

title: Monocular Depth Estimation with Atrous Convolutions
description: Surveyed standard approaches for monocular depth estimation, leading to a published survey paper analyzing architectural trade-offs.
Explored the feasibility of integrating atrous convolutions into a ResNet-50-based depth estimation model to enhance spatial feature extraction.
Achieved a significant reduction in model parameters without compromising overall performance, improving computational efficiency.
Conducted comparative evaluations with existing methods, highlighting the strengths and limitations of atrous convolutions in depth estimation.

title: Neural Networks from Scratch
description: Built a neural network framework from scratch, implementing core components, achieving 95% accuracy on MNIST dataset.
Optimized forward / backward propagation for efficient prediction and gradient computation, reducing training time by 25%.
Integrated advanced features like early stopping, dropout, batch normalization, and regularization, improving model generalization by 10%.
Developed custom optimization algorithms (RMSProp, Adam) to improve convergence rates, accelerating training by 30%.
Implemented multi-layer networks with ReLU, Sigmoid, and Softmax activations for complex classification tasks, outperforming baseline models.

title: Intrusion Detection System
description: Performed exploratory data analysis and feature selection on the NSL-KDD dataset, improving feature relevance and reducing dimensionality by 15%.
Implemented Kernel SVM with rbf and polynomial kernels, and Random Forest models with cross-validation for hyperparameter tuning, achieving 94% accuracy in classifying intrusion types.
Enhanced model generalization and performance, improving the F1-score by 8% from the baseline models.
Managed the end-to-end implementation, ensuring seamless project execution from data preprocessing and feature selection to model evaluation and testing, resulting in a robust, deployable system.
Utilized ensemble methods to boost model performance and reduce overfitting, leading to a 6% increase in accuracy.

title: Salary Prediction System
description: Developed a salary prediction tool using Glassdoor data to estimate salaries for data science roles.
Built a Selenium-based scraper to gather and update data from Glassdoor daily.
Engineered features from 200+ job descriptions, quantifying the importance of certain skills.
Analyzed 5,000+ job listings, identifying salary trends and skill demand for data science positions.
Optimized Linear, Lasso, Random Forest regressors with GridSearchCV, improving accuracy by 15%.
Visualized salary trends, aiding decision-making for both job seekers and employers.
